placements.title: Ratified interface protocols governing asynchronous execution and state retrieval
placements.frame: How do operational interface contracts structure client interactions to ensure resilience, predictability, and responsiveness?

placements.title: Immediate receipt dispatch replaces blocking calls to guarantee non-blocking responsiveness and resilient work tracking
placements.frame: How are long-running execution contracts structured between immediate receipt return and asynchronous polling or piggybacked retrieval?
placements.why: Wynn and Xena confirm the ratified async job contract: remember dispatches in seconds with a receipt, leaving execution to be watched via cursor polling or piggybacked on later calls without blocking or risking lost work.
